verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Mangopay offers a hosted KYC/KYB flow that platforms must integrate for all user types. Nothing documents tiered or tunable onboarding, deferring verification until a payout threshold, or per-seller requirements-due states. Seller onboarding is a fair axis for a marketplace payments platform, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops user, onboarding friction is tunable — collect the minimum to start selling and gather the rest before payout thresholds, with clear requirements-due states per seller
